title: Alkyne-tagged ribitol-5-phosphate derivatives for metabolic labelling of alpha-dystroglycan
content:
RSC Chem. Biol., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5CB00187K, Communication

Lloyd D. Murphy, Saeed Akkad, Angelo Lopez, Morgan E. Batiste-Simms, Greg L. McNeil, Eva W. Wan, Kathryn E. Huxley, Luke Julyan, Mia Shandell, Lianne I. Willems
A chemical reporter strategy is described for the metabolic labelling of ribitol-5-phosphate containing glycans, enabling bioorthogonal tagging of the glycoprotein α-dystroglycan.
